ownership.coordinator: agent harness process that owns canonical inspection and commit sequencing
ownership.worker: bounded external executor that receives one prepared descriptor and returns a candidate result

worker.output: candidate external result returned to coordinator

retry.worker_failure: retry only while the descriptor remains current
retry.reconnect: reinspect graph before redispatch or commit
retry.stale_input: discard candidate result and prepare current work again
retry.duplicate_delivery: resubmit only through canonical commit and trust idempotency response
retry.writer_conflict: back off and retry commit through the coordinator; never bypass the lease

flow: prepare independent visual and voice work items
serialize commit batches through the coordinator
reinspect canonical state after every commit batch
run QA/recovery for missing, failed, or stale units
assemble ProductionPack and Resolve export only after canonical fan-in
